summary: Holley Inc. filed an 8-K on September 23, 2026 disclosing a voluntary prepayment of $10 million of outstanding principal under its first lien term loan facility, made September 22, 2026, with a supporting press release. Including this payment, Holley has repaid $125 million of debt since September 2023, funded entirely by free cash flow, cutting its Total Leverage Ratio from a 5.67x peak toward a below-3.5x year-end target and roughly 3.0x long-term goal, generating about $5 million in annualized net interest savings. No board recommendation, advisor, or change of control is involved; routine deleveraging disclosure, not a special situation.
